display.title: Episode 119: The Needles and Toothpicks, Chapter 2 (Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains the giant monthly brachah of Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan, the month of redemption, and the funny end of the needles and toothpicks parable answers the king's question.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan 5744. Uncle Yossi explains that Hashem gives blessings for an hour, a day and a week, but on Shabbos Mevarchim comes a 'jumbo' brachah for the whole month, and that Nissan is special: our fathers were redeemed in Nissan and Moshiach will come in Nissan. Everyone practices answering Amen to the blessing of the new month, then joins a Hakochainik march out of golus. After a recap of the king's question and Shimon's useless toothpicks and needles, a nine-year-old guest recites the Shema. In the conclusion, the father sends the toothpicks and the needles with two different salesmen, who meet at the fair and simply swap loads. The father explains that Shimon traded real gold for junk, while the salesmen only swapped one piece of junk for another. So too, a Jew who leaves Hashem for idols loses everything, while other nations merely trade one idol for another. A listener's letter and a contest announcement close the show.
display.lesson: Leaving Hashem for anything else is like trading gold for junk; stay with the One who is truly valuable.
